prompt:
continue my research, log attached. yes, that intake summary was right. let's start exploring.
Input files: research-log.md
assertions: The reply begins with a progress marker identifying Phase 1.
The reply includes a briefing with four labeled sections covering key debates, major voices, patterns, and open questions.
The briefing is roughly 300 to 500 words long (it fails if under 250 or over 600 words).
The reply presents a mind map, either as an HTML page built from the skill's mind map template or as an indented text tree.
The mind map has 4 to 6 top-level angles, each with 2 or 3 narrower angles, and every angle has a saturation value between 0 and 1 (or, for a text tree, a crowdedness label).
No mind map label is phrased as a research question; labels are short topics.
The reply does not tell the user which angle they should choose or which one is best.

Every link in the reply points to a page the transcript shows Claude opened (fetched) during this session. Every DOI (as a doi.org link or as text) either was opened itself or appears exactly in the list of DOIs found on pages Claude opened (shown under FILES or DOIS ON OPENED PAGES). A DOI seen only in search results doesn't count. Links and DOIs in the mind map count too.
The reply asks the user which direction interests them and why.
The reply asks the user no more than two questions.
